reasons: Deviation is correctly identified: the existing convenience right (p0044-p0045, one month's notice) is conditioned on open-ended early termination charges 'specified in Attachment A' with no refund of prepaid charges, which falls short of the preferred position (convenience termination without penalty plus pro-rata refund).

The redline is targeted and directionally correct: it edits only the payment subparagraph (p0046), preserves Customer's obligation to pay charges accrued through the termination date, negates early termination charges/penalties, and adds the pro-rata refund of prepaid charges required by the model language. The existing 30-day-equivalent notice and the absence of any IBM convenience right are left intact, so the rule is fully covered.

Failed check 'Customer convenience termination present' is a phrasing artifact — the convenience grant sits in unedited p0044 and the edit targets the fee subparagraph, so the regex would not match the changed text.
High changed-character ratio (0.866) is justified: p0046 is a one-line fee subparagraph that cannot be brought to the playbook position without replacement; no unnecessary scope was added.

Comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice, explains what changed and why, and offers the playbook fallback (cap at three months' charges) rather than conceding it in the redline, consistent with redline guidance.
